name: WEC Energy Group

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (WEC Energy Group Logo.svg)

description: WEC Energy Group is a holding company for regulated electric and gas utilities in Wisconsin, Illinois (Peoples Gas and North Shore Gas in Chicago), Minnesota and Michigan, with 8,375 MW of owned generation. In 2025 about 58% of utility revenue was electric and about 42% natural gas, and Illinois is gas-only. Rates are set state by state (ROE 9.8% for its Wisconsin utilities, 9.38% for the Chicago gas utilities, 9.65% for Minnesota gas), so earnings grow with capital spending approved in rates. It also holds an equity interest in American Transmission Company (ATC, equity income) and a non-utility energy infrastructure segment (We Power plants leased to Wisconsin Electric, Bluewater gas storage and wind parks) that earned about a quarter of 2025 earnings.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Electric Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4931 (Electric & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR. Note that gas sold 42% of utility revenue in 2025 yet it is filed as an electric utility.

businessLines.name: Wisconsin
businessLines.how: Customers pay monthly state-set rates for electricity and gas; fuel and purchased gas are largely passed through, and profit comes from the authorised return (9.8% ROE) on capital invested in plants, wires and pipes.
businessLines.description: Regulated electric (Wisconsin Electric, Wisconsin Public Service, Wisconsin Power) and natural gas utilities in Wisconsin.
